title: Aroha
tagline: Aroha is a Omnichain Tokenized Funds Aggregrator in a blockchain frictionless way where users can acquire T-Bills or Tokenized Funds without having switch chains simply by buying them with USDC tokens and getting yield out of it.

prizes.title: Most Innovative use of Pyth pull oracle (Price Feeds)

description:
Our project fintech platform designed to deliver a seamless Web2.5 experience for users investing in tokenized funds. We simplify the process by keeping all crypto-related complexities under the hood. 

From onboarding to payment processing, we ensure a frictionless journey, eliminating the need for users to set up wallets or navigate blockchain intricacies. 

With integrated on-ramp and off-ramp solutions, we’ve got every aspect of the experience covered—making investing in tokenized assets as straightforward and accessible as traditional finance.
how_its_made:
LayerZero Integration: Facilitates omnichain communication, allowing liquidity aggregation and transactions across multiple chains.

Uniswap Hooks: Enhances the Uniswap protocol with cross-chain functionality powered by LayerZero, allowing interactions with liquidity pools on remote chains. This integration ensures superior pricing and deeper liquidity.

Web3Auth Integration: Simplifies user onboarding with a no-modal SDK, providing a frictionless and user-friendly Web3 experience with WalletServicesPlugin for On-Ramp and Off-Ramp.

WorldID Integration: Verifies user authenticity, effectively distinguishing human users from bots to ensure secure and trustworthy interactions.

UniChain: Serves as the primary origin blockchain, centralizing core operations and ensuring reliability.

Base: Provides access to tokenized funds, unlocking new opportunities for liquidity deployment and financial innovation.

Zircuit & Scroll: Play a pivotal role in supplying liquidity, strengthening the ecosystem’s financial infrastructure by bringing existing tokenized funds from other chains to them.

Polygon: Bridges existing tokenized funds, extending their utility and accessibility within the ecosystem.

USDC: As a payment token for the omnichain tokens buy.
